schema_document.title: Feature Schema Specification
schema_document.normative_note: Candidate definitions only. No feature is approved for model use until sensor, units, calibration, sampling, preprocessing, model input metadata, and golden vectors are verified.

input_contract.input_mode: TBD: raw time-series vs engineered feature vector must match actual Edge Impulse export
input_contract.normalization: TBD; fit only on training split and freeze parameters
input_contract.invalid_data_policy: Reject/invalidate window by default; no silent zero-fill, hold-last, or interpolation

features.name: Accelerometer X raw channel
features.formula: Direct driver sample; no scaling unless explicitly defined by the sensor driver contract.

valid_range.basis: sensor datasheet + configured range + calibration evidence

features.missing_policy: Invalidate affected window unless an approved schema-specific policy says otherwise

features.name: Accelerometer Y raw channel
features.formula: Direct driver sample; no scaling unless explicitly defined by the sensor driver contract.

valid_range.basis: sensor datasheet + configured range + calibration evidence

features.missing_policy: Invalidate affected window unless an approved schema-specific policy says otherwise

features.name: Accelerometer Z raw channel
features.formula: Direct driver sample; no scaling unless explicitly defined by the sensor driver contract.

valid_range.basis: sensor datasheet + configured range + calibration evidence

features.missing_policy: Invalidate affected window unless an approved schema-specific policy says otherwise

features.name: Accelerometer magnitude
features.unit: m/s^2 only if all input channels are calibrated in m/s^2; otherwise TBD
features.formula: sqrt(ax*ax + ay*ay + az*az), with finite/overflow checks

valid_range.basis: approved IMU full scale and calibration

quality_requirements: all three source axes valid, fresh, finite, same frame and compatible timestamps
features.missing_policy: Output invalid if any required source axis is invalid

features.name: Tilt estimate about X axis
features.formula: Candidate static-acceleration estimate: atan2(ay, sqrt(ax*ax + az*az)) * 180/pi; exact axis/sign convention must be verified against mounting frame.

valid_range.basis: formula convention only; physical eligibility requires approved mounting/frame and validity tests

features.missing_policy: Output invalid if inputs invalid or dynamic acceleration makes the estimate unsuitable under the approved policy
verification: bench tilt-angle sweep against reference inclinometer

features.name: Tilt estimate about Y axis
features.formula: Candidate static-acceleration estimate: atan2(-ax, sqrt(ay*ay + az*az)) * 180/pi; exact axis/sign convention must be verified against mounting frame.

valid_range.basis: formula convention only; physical eligibility requires approved mounting/frame and validity tests

features.missing_policy: Output invalid if inputs invalid or dynamic acceleration makes the estimate unsuitable under the approved policy
verification: bench tilt-angle sweep against reference inclinometer

features.name: Soil sensor raw output
features.formula: Direct driver reading; preserve original value.

valid_range.basis: sensor electrical specification and ADC configuration

features.missing_policy: Invalid if read fails, stale, or outside approved electrical range

features.name: YL-83 module raw output
features.formula: Direct driver reading; do not map to rainfall or rain rate without a validated reference calibration.

valid_range.basis: module electrical characteristics and ADC configuration

features.missing_policy: Invalid if read fails, stale, or outside approved electrical range
verification: reference-method comparison if rainfall is intended

features.name: HX710B raw ADC output
features.formula: Direct signed/raw conversion according to the selected HX710B driver and datasheet; preserve raw count and sign semantics.

valid_range.basis: ADC datasheet, driver representation, saturation behavior

features.missing_policy: Invalid on timeout, saturation, conversion error, or missing transducer configuration

approval_gates: Confirm actual sensor model/revision and driver units
Approve calibration and channel quality policies
Approve input mode, sampling rate, window length, stride and preprocessing
Approve target/label contract and time alignment
Export actual Edge Impulse model metadata and match exact input dimensions/order
Assign stable feature indexes only after canonical input schema is frozen
Generate schema SHA-256 and version it
Pass host and ESP32-S3 golden vectors within approved per-feature tolerances
